contents.text: What does a running CP-200 do when it loses contact with the plant control system?
The pump keeps running at its last set point. Error E-310 clears itself when communication returns.

CP-200 Troubleshooting Guide › 2 Controller error codes › Error E-310: communication lost
## Error E-310: communication lost
Error E-310 means the controller hasn't heard from the plant control system for 30 seconds.
The pump keeps running at its last set point.
Causes, most likely first:
1. A network fault.
2. The plant control system was restarted.
E-310 clears itself when communication returns.

CP-200 Troubleshooting Guide › 2 Controller error codes › Error E-106: supply undervoltage
## Error E-106: supply undervoltage
Error E-106 means the supply voltage stayed below 90 percent of its nominal value for more than 5 seconds.
The pump restarts by itself 30 seconds after the voltage returns, unless automatic restart is disabled.
Causes, most likely first:
1. A weak supply during the start of another large motor.
2. A failing transformer tap changer.
E-106 clears itself.
If it repeats, record the times and ask the plant electrical engineer to check the supply.

CP-200 Troubleshooting Guide › 2 Controller error codes › Error E-203: dry running
## Error E-203: dry running
Error E-203 means the dry-running sensor in the casing detected no liquid.
The controller trips the pump at once, because a few seconds of dry running damage the mechanical seal.
Causes, most likely first:
1. The casing wasn't vented after maintenance.
2. The suction tank ran empty.
Vent the casing until water flows without air, then reset E-203.
Check the seal for leaks after the restart.

CP-200 Troubleshooting Guide › 2 Controller error codes › Error E-102: supply phase missing
## Error E-102: supply phase missing
Error E-102 means one of the three supply phases is missing.
The controller checks the phases at every start and once a second while the pump runs.
Causes, most likely first:
1. A blown fuse in the motor feeder.
2. A loose terminal in the motor control center.
Have an electrician check the fuses and terminals.
E-102 clears itself when all three phases return.
